node.title: L1 two-petal bounded-small-support automatic B11 anchor closure
node.statement: In a maximal L1 sunflower, let a>=z be the two positive petal support sizes, r the background agreement count, and d the exact core defect. If z<=A for a fixed A>=1, the threshold, per-petal defect cap, and nonzero numerator imply d<=ell+A-1 and G_R=(ell-r)+(ell-a)<=2A. The proved B11 background-petal gate therefore bounds the whole class polynomially. At z=1 one has exactly r=ell-1 and d=a in {ell-1,ell}; hence every unpaid singleton-petal mixed contributor touches at least three petals.
